name: How much does custom trim installation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does custom trim installation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of custom trim installation varies based on several factors, including the type of trim material (e.g., MDF, solid wood), the complexity of the profile, the total lineal feet to be installed, and any necessary surface preparation or existing trim removal. More intricate designs or premium wood species will typically incur higher costs. We provide a detailed estimate after an on-site evaluation, which allows us to account for all specific project requirements and give you an accurate quote for your home in areas like Meridian or Eagle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom trim installation costs depend on material, profile complexity, lineal feet, and prep work; an on-site evaluation provides an accurate estimate.
